name: Miura Daisuke
source:
26 years old mathematics teacher from Sayone's school.
He is also the adviser of the mathematics club. He is making the members of this club to participate in a suspicious part time work program.
Likes gambling a lot, earns money from it, and most likely has also a variety of other side jobs.

[Edited and translated from the [url=http://www.ray-software.net/tokihako/index.html]official website[/url]]
